ideas.headline: Why Is Cisco Stock Falling on Thursday? (Benzinga, 2026-10-15 18:12 UTC): attackers are using a critical 9.8-rated flaw in Cisco Secure Email Gateway (CVE-2026-76519)
ideas.why_not_priced_in: Cisco is down about 3.3% today, 3.7% behind the S&P 500. The cause is a flaw in its Secure Email Gateway, a small product in a company that expects $18-18.2B in revenue this quarter. A fix has been available since September 14, so this is mostly a scary headline, not lasting damage to the business. The flaw only works on gateways with one specific setting turned on, and the US cybersecurity agency (CISA) has simply told users to patch. The rest of the drop is the broad sell-off in AI hardware, not news about Cisco itself. The stock has already bounced from its low of about $108.95 to about $109.93, so it is no longer falling fast. Cisco has not confirmed its next earnings date. Calendars estimate November 10-11, 2026, about four weeks away and well outside the 3-trading-day limit.
ideas.plain_reason: A fixable bug in one small product shouldn't knock this much off a giant company.

ideas.headline: Alcoa reports Q3 2026 results (Oct 15, after close): adjusted EPS $1.82 vs about $1.47-1.54 expected; stock +7.8% on Oct 16 (~+7.9% vs SPY)
ideas.why_not_priced_in: Profit per share beat estimates by about 20%. Full-year production and shipment targets were kept, aluminum output grew for a sixth quarter in a row, and the company is selling part of its Massena East site for up to $315M in cash. The CEO says global aluminum stocks are the lowest in years (42 days of use), which supports prices. Revenue missed slightly, but that came from lower metal prices, not lost business. Some of the jump is a sector-wide aluminum move (Century Aluminum is up about 6%), but the report alone produced a clear gain of at least 2%. Our tests show beats with jumps over 5% kept drifting higher for about 20 days. AA is a mid-size cyclical stock (about $11B), so it should be sized as a smaller company (up to 5%) with a wide trailing stop of about 15%. Its next report should be around late January 2027. That date is not confirmed, but it is far outside the 3-day window.
ideas.plain_reason: Profits beat forecasts by a lot, the outlook held, and aluminum supply is tight.
